data.name: Jitendra Rajendra Gosavi
data.player_statement:
A complete player, Jitendra Rajendra Gosavi has made a big mark in cricket. With 59 turns at the crease, they've hit a top score of 38, with an average of 10.33 and a quick strike rate of 117.81. Their knack for hitting big shots is evident with 31 sixes and 39 fours.

Equally good at bowling, they've bowled 351.4 overs, taking 134 wickets at an economy rate of 6.99. Despite a few wides, their accuracy is top-notch, making them a key player for their team.
